orgs.credentials.intro: Some roles at your church ask for a background check or training. This page shows what is on record for you and when each one is due to be renewed.

js.credentials.detail.expiringToday: Current until the end of today. Your coordinator can help you renew it.
js.credentials.detail.pending: Your coordinator has recorded this, and a second person still needs to confirm it. Nothing is wrong on your side.
js.credentials.detail.lapsed: This ended on {date}. That happens to everyone from time to time, and renewing is usually quick. Your coordinator can help.
js.credentials.detail.revoked: Your coordinator ended this one. They can tell you more and help you with the next step.
js.credentials.detail.missing: Nothing is recorded for you yet. If a role you would like needs this, your coordinator can help you get started.
js.credentials.contact: To renew, or if you have a question, talk to your safeguarding coordinator: {names}.
js.credentials.contactOffice: To renew, or if you have a question, please ask the church office.
js.credentials.emptyListNote: If a list or a page that you used to see is empty, it can be because a credential is waiting to be renewed. It is not a mistake on your part, and only your coordinators can see these dates besides you.

orgs.consentPurposes.title: Consent purposes
orgs.consentPurposes.intro: What people in your organization can agree to, such as a newsletter or photos. When you change the text of a purpose, its version goes up and earlier consents show as given on an older version.
orgs.consentPurposes.empty: No purposes yet. Add the first one below.
orgs.consentPurposes.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It cannot be changed later, and it must be unique across all organizations, so something like "yourchurch-trips" works well.
orgs.consentPurposes.textHelp: Say in plain words what the person agrees to. This exact text is kept as evidence with every consent.
orgs.consentPurposes.minAgeHelp: Below this age a guardian gives the consent. Leave empty for no minimum, or 18 for a marketing purpose.
orgs.consentPurposes.guardian: A guardian must always give this consent
orgs.consentPurposes.marketingHelp: Direct marketing can never be consented to for a minor, and the minimum age is 18 when you leave it empty.
js.consentPurposes.savedVersion: Saved. The text changed, so this is now version {version}.
js.consentPurposes.retired: The purpose is retired. It is no longer offered, and the evidence stays.
js.consentPurposes.confirmDelete: Delete the purpose "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
js.consentPurposes.hasRecords: People have already given consent to this purpose, so it cannot be deleted. Retire it instead; the evidence stays.
js.consentPurposes.noAccess: Only the owners, admins and registrars of this organization can manage its consent purposes.
js.consentPurposes.notMember: This account is not an active member of that organization.
js.consentPurposes.unavailable: Consents are not set up on this server.
js.consentPurposes.loadFailed: The purposes could not be loaded. Try again later.
